result.topic_en: Gauss gives the difference Dec.(m/M) − Dec.(M/m) as ±4Σε in five cases according to integrality and parity conditions, followed by a sign table of a correction term ψ indexed by the signs of a b, A B, α β, with notes on which columns apply depending on the parity of ½(M−1) and ½(m−1).
